comments.text: From the hand-carved Guoliang Tunnel now hosting tourists [29:42] to the Bailong Elevator rising up sandstone pillars [45:31], dramatic landscapes increasingly come with big tourist infrastructure. Do you see structures like these as a great way to let more people experience wild places, or do they take away from raw natural solitude?
